title: A Pairwise Spectral Discrepancy Criterion Equivalent to the Riemann Hypothesis: Core Identities and Positivity Mechanism (Candidate — Pending Independent Verification)
description: A formally reconstructed candidate criterion equivalent to the Riemann Hypothesis under a stated distributional Weil framework. From the Hadamard expansion of the completed zeta function we derive the natural kernel K, a test object H_0 with H_0'' in L^1, the pairing weight w_H, and the pairwise discrepancy P_gamma(delta) = delta^2 M_2/(2 U^2 D_+ D_-) with an explicit positive-coefficient factorization. The criterion is Q = Q'_RH iff delta_rho = 0 for all zeros, assembled over functional-equation orbits. Core identities (O1-O5) and checks (C1-C5) are formalized from original definitions. This is NOT a claim that RH has been proved; independent external verification (INVALID-first) is required and pending.
